aspect: Shame is the reported emotion, not fear
description: Adults describe the loss of privacy and cleanliness as the part that destroyed their sense of themselves as adults. It is rarely asked about and reliably volunteered.
No products, no privacy, no water, no disposal, in a mixed shelter. Women and girls report deliberately restricting food and fluid to reduce the problem.
energy_note: Eating less, so that you bleed less.

aspect: Children's illness cycles compound the developmental effect
description: Repeated diarrhoeal disease in early childhood produces stunting and cognitive effects that outlast the siege by a lifetime.
energy_note: A permanent effect from temporary plumbing.

aspect: It is the detail people cannot say afterwards
description: Survivors will describe shelling in detail and will not describe this, which means it is absent from most accounts and most assessments.
energy_note: The part that never makes it into the testimony.
